## Why This Is Asked

This question probes building a low-latency, cross-platform media pipeline bridging native GPU code with React Native, covering threading, memory budgets, and backpressure.

## Key Concepts

- GPU compute paths: Metal, Vulkan/GL
- Native JS bridge: TurboModule/JSI
- Real-time cadence and buffering
- Backpressure and frame-dropping
- Memory budgeting and thermal constraints

## Code Example

```javascript
// Minimal API sketch
startPipeline({ width: 1280, height: 720, filters: [{ id:'denoise', params:{sigma:0.5}}] });
addFilter('colorGrade', { look:'cinematic' });
onFrame((frame) => { /* render frame.texture to RN surface */ });
stopPipeline();
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How to measure end-to-end latency and jitter on heterogeneous devices?
- How to handle devices without Vulkan/Metal support while preserving API stability?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests cross‑platform native bridges, queues, and lifecycle handling in React Native. It mirrors real apps needing non‑intrusive, controlled in‑app notices.

## Key Concepts
- Native module bridging (Swift/Kotlin)
- Single‑producer, single‑consumer queue
- Lifecycle: keep banners alive during navigation, cancel on unmount
- Rotation handling and memory bounds

## Code Example
```javascript
import { BannerQueue } from 'react-native'

// Enqueue a banner
BannerQueue.showBanner({
  id: 'tip1',
  title: 'Network',
  message: 'Connecting…',
  duration: 3000
})

// Dismiss explicitly
BannerQueue.dismissBanner('tip1')
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test this across platforms with varying thread priorities?
- How would you extend to allow per-banner actions (tap to open)?

// Minimal usage sketch

onFrame((frame) => { /* process frame */ });
stopStream();

- How would you evolve API to support dynamic switching between cameras?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design performance-sensitive on-device AI inference with cross-platform bridging, memory management, backpressure, and lifecycle.

## Key Concepts
- React Native TurboModules and JSI
- TensorFlow Lite, Metal/NNAPI delegates
- Real-time multithreading and frames management
- Memory budgeting and buffer reuse
- Backpressure and lifecycle cleanup

## Code Example
```javascript
// TS-like sketch
import { startInference, pauseInference, onResult } from 'my-infer-module';
startInference('/models/plant.tflite', { width, height }, { fps: 30 });
onResult((r)=> console.log(r.top1, r.confidence));
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle model drift and quantization adjustments?
- How would you adapt to variable camera framerates and power modes?
